name: mirage
text: Parlay check 14:08 + a finding on your profit question: the engine's ledger profit has slid from -$256 to -$326 today, but that is almost exactly the $73 of parlay collateral now locked for open parlays, which the ledger counts as spent until those parlays settle. It is not a trading loss: realized parlay P&L is still the 3 early hits, -$7.09. I logged a fix (TR7) so the wallet figure adds that collateral back. No parlay settings changed this check; cash $9.86 and the $80 open cap are what limit new fills until you add money or parlays settle.
